selection_rationale.included: 15 diverse X assignments covering uniform, heterogeneous, asymmetric, and coder-heavy patterns
selection_rationale.excluded: assignments where e1=e2 with weak models (dominated by e1=e2=large in clean cube); assignments with identical capability profiles to included ones
selection_rationale.note: 30 configs is large enough for meaningful search comparison but small enough for exhaustive ground truth on 8-16 tasks

state_features.informational_boundary: features encode only the config structure; no task-specific or gold-derived information

incremental_cost.definition: estimated real tokens to evaluate a config on one task
incremental_cost.formula: sum of per-node estimated tokens based on model and context length
incremental_cost.note: estimated cost used for cost-aware acquisition; actual cost from real evaluation replaces it once revealed

q_b_baseline.method: evaluate configs by scalarized utility w=[1,0,0] (quality only) under budget constraint C<=B
q_b_baseline.note: this baseline tests whether multi-objective search provides value beyond single-objective optimization

info_boundary.allowed: (1) features of any config; (2) (Q,C,L) of revealed configs from current run; (3) pre-estimated incremental cost
info_boundary.forbidden: (1) true (Q,C,L) of unrevealed configs; (2) Reference Cube results as labels; (3) fault30 v1 results (execution defect); (4) any gold-derived features
